rules.title: "{1} of" is "{1} have"
rules.message: "{0}" is how it sounds; it is written "{1} have".
positives: I could of told you that yesterday.
You should of asked first.
We would of shipped it on time.
decoys: Most of what we could, of course, was done.
I could have told you.
The view would of the two be better?

rules.title: "for all intents and purposes"
rules.message: The phrase is "for all intents and purposes".
positives: For all intensive purposes the launch is done.
It is, for all intensive purposes, finished.
for all intensive purposes we agree
decoys: For all intents and purposes the launch is done.
The intensive purposes of the course were clear.
for all purposes, intensive or not

rules.title: "per se"
positives: It is not a bug per say, more a gap.
Not wrong per say.
I don't mind the delay per say.
decoys: It is not a bug per se.
The fee is ten dollars per, say, month.
What do you say per item?

rules.title: "one and the same"
rules.message: The phrase is "one and the same".
positives: The two teams are one in the same.
They are basically one in the same.
Those bugs were one in the same.
decoys: The two teams are one and the same.
Put one in the same folder as the other.
Is it one in the same row?

rules.title: "case in point"
positives: Case and point: the last release.
That outage is a case and point.
a perfect case and point
decoys: Case in point: the last release.
Every case and every point was reviewed.
the case, and its point, were clear

rules.title: "sneak peek"
rules.message: A quick look is a "peek"; a "peak" is a summit.
positives: Here is a sneak peak of the new design.
Want a sneak peak?
Two sneak peaks this week.
decoys: Here is a sneak peek of the new design.
Traffic hit its peak at noon.
We had to sneak past the peak hours.

rules.title: "free rein"
rules.message: The idiom comes from riding: "free rein".
positives: She has free reign over the roadmap.
Give them free reign.
We had free reign on the design.
decoys: She has free rein over the roadmap.
His reign was free of scandal.
a free and fair reign

rules.title: "bated breath"
positives: We waited with baited breath.
I'm waiting with baited breath for the results.
baited breath all week
decoys: We waited with bated breath.
The hook was baited before dawn.
Take a breath before you answer.

rules.title: "pique" your interest
rules.message: To stir interest is to "pique" it.
positives: That talk peaked my interest.
It might peak your interest.
The demo peaks their interest every time.
decoys: That talk piqued my interest.
Interest rates peaked in May.
At its peak, my interest was high.

rules.title: "deep-seated"
positives: It is a deep-seeded fear.
a deep seeded problem in the team
Their doubts are deep-seeded.
decoys: It is a deep-seated fear.
We seeded the deep end of the database.
The tray was seeded deep in the soil.
